description: A hand-set voltage source with a display that reads out either in volts or as a note name.

params.text: Sets the whole-volt part of the output, -10V to +10V.
Adds a volt either way on top of that, snapped to twelfths of a volt, to tenths, or to nothing at all according to the menu.
Switches the output between the voltage set on the panel and 0V.

inputs.text: Adds to the voltage set by the two knobs; the total is clamped to ±11V.
A trigger here flips the output on or off; with ON set to Hold the output instead follows this jack combined with the button, on when exactly one of the two is raised.

outputs.text: The set voltage, or 0V while the module is switched off.

notes: While Fine is snapping to twelfths of a volt the display reads note names: 0V shows as c4, an i before the letter marks a sharp, and readings above 6V or below -4V end in h or l.
Either of the other two Fine settings puts the display into plain volts.
The module comes up switched on, and the lamp on the button stays lit while it is.
menu: Fine: Snap to 1/12V — rounds the fine knob to twelfths of a volt and puts the display into note names
Fine: Snap to 1/10V — rounds the fine knob to tenths of a volt and puts the display into volts
Fine: Don't snap — leaves the fine knob continuous and puts the display into volts
ON: Toggle — makes each trigger at the ON input flip the output on or off
ON: Hold — makes the output state the ON input and the button combined, on when exactly one of the two is raised
Quantize CV like Fine knob — rounds the voltage arriving at the CV input the same way the fine knob is rounded

inputs.0:
continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the knobs alone; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to ±11V.
inputs.1:
high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads the ON button alone.
